rationale: The translation preserves the source's probability-space setting, measurable real random variable, positive real exponent, absolute p-th moment, strict tail event, exact coefficient and exponent, and positive-half-line integral. Its decisive difference is removal of the source's finite-right-hand-side scope: it asserts the layer-cake formula unconditionally in ENNReal. This is a genuine nonvacuous strengthening, while the added conditional toReal conjunct is redundant under the main equality. Therefore translation implies source, source does not imply translation, and the accepted classification is faithful-stronger.
